description:
`closure_path` in `dev/scripts/check-campaign-producing-closure.py` requires the protocol documents of a campaign to lie in one directory. A byte-identical archived copy of a protocol document fails the `campaign-producing-closure` CI step, while the Rust lookups count identical copies as one file.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The closure check counts byte-identical copies of a protocol document as one document, through the same rule as `tuning_campaign_support::repository::distinct_contents`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Documents with the same identity and different bytes remain an error, covered by the script's self-test.
- [hard] REQ-03: The check holds no hard-coded `dev/` path or archive-path exclusion list.
title: Producing-closure check requires protocol documents in one directory
